Accessibility Statement

Zeovus Ventures Private Limited ("Zeovus") is committed to providing an accessible, inclusive, and user-friendly website experience for all individuals, including persons with disabilities, regardless of their abilities, technology, or the devices they use to access our website.

We recognise the importance of digital accessibility and strive to ensure that our website is designed, developed, and maintained in accordance with applicable Indian laws and internationally recognised accessibility standards.

Our approach to website accessibility is guided by the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA, developed by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).
To support an accessible online experience, we aim to:

Follow Accessibility Standards: Work towards meeting the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA, which provide internationally recognised recommendations for making web content more accessible to people with disabilities.

Support Different Devices and Technologies: Ensure that our website is designed to function across commonly used devices, including desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones, while supporting compatibility with assistive technologies such as screen readers and keyboard navigation.

Improve Website Usability: Promote clear navigation, readable content, appropriate text contrast, accessible website structures, and alternative text for meaningful images to improve usability for all visitors.

Maintain and Improve Accessibility: Review our website periodically and make reasonable efforts to identify and address accessibility barriers as part of our ongoing website development and maintenance.
We recognise that accessibility is an ongoing process and remain committed to improving the usability and accessibility of our digital platforms.
For the best browsing experience, we recommend using an updated web browser and the latest available version of any assistive technology.
Accessibility Assistance and Feedback

If you experience difficulty accessing any information, navigating our website, or using any of its features, we encourage you to contact us. We welcome feedback and will make reasonable efforts to address accessibility-related concerns and provide assistance wherever practicable.
